title: RuleSet
description: The ordered list of firewall Rules that apply to traffic entering from one Interface/Zone and leaving through another (RA R-014, R-014.4). The (from, to) pair is a match criterion, so RuleSets for different pairs never overlap: ordering is only meaningful inside one RuleSet and it is the position in 'spec.rules'. Exactly one RuleSet per (from, to) pair (validator check). 'any' is NOT allowed for from/to: use a Zone instead (RA open issue 4). Traffic for a pair with no RuleSet gets Default Deny (R-033). NAT is a section of the Rule: 'snat' rewrites the source of accepted flows (R-002), 'dnat' rewrites the destination (R-003). A dnat Rule matches on the destination and service BEFORE translation (the public address), then translates to 'translateIpTo' / 'translateServiceTo'.

addressList.description: Either ["any"] or a non-empty list of Address / AddressGroup names.

serviceList.description: Either ["any"] or a non-empty list of Service / ServiceGroup names.

translateIpTo.description: Address object providing the translated address. snat: optional — when omitted, the primary address of the outgoing Interface is used (masquerade); when set, the Address acts as an IP pool (subnet or range). dnat: required — a single-host Address (/32 or /128) or a range.

translateServiceTo.description: dnat only, optional. Service object with exactly one protocol entry and a single port; the destination port is rewritten to it. When omitted, the port is left unchanged (same as the Rule's service).

name.description: Unique within the RuleSet; reported in Traffic Log events (R-026) and in the UI; stable anchor for Git diffs when rules are reordered.

log.description: Which Flow events to emit for this Rule. Default Deny always logs (R-033).

schedule.description: Reserved for a future Schedule kind. Not implemented in v1alpha1.
